heroTitle: Launch {{siteTitle}} with the core routes already in motion.
heroBody: This starter template includes a homepage, one docs path, and a sample post so the content model is visible from the first run.

featureBlocks.title: A runnable publishing stack with just enough content to orient the team.
featureBlocks.body: Use the included docs page and blog post as reference points, then replace the copy with your own publication workflow.
bullets: Local studio host from the same workspace

featureBlocks.title: Cloudflare Pages is optional, not mandatory.
featureBlocks.body: The generated site stays local-first, with an opt-in preset for Cloudflare Pages when you want static deployment scaffolding.
bullets: Preset files added only when requested

ctaBlocks.title: Replace the starter content, keep the workflow.
ctaBlocks.body: The sample docs and post are there to show the route and content shape, not to lock you into a theme.

seo.title: {{siteTitle}}
seo.description: A starter publishing site for {{siteTitle}} with docs, blog, and local studio workflows.
